source_agency: Isanti County Finance & Property Services Division
review_notes: Provenance: county Property Tax Coordinator delivery and year conventions are supported by the supplied email thread and follow-up reply. Monetary field definitions remain pending.
October 13 is the listing date supplied by the user and filename. All EFFDATE and LTRDT values are 7-Oct-26; do not claim balances are effective October 13.
PARID values are nine-digit strings and match GIS parcel IDs after punctuation removal. No padding or numeric coercion is needed.

TAXYR=2025 is report assessment year (payable 2026). ASMTYR is the individual charge assessment year. Only earlier ASMTYR rows establish prior-year delinquency; equal years establish overdue first-half current-year installments.
Do not map abbreviated money columns to canonical balances without county definitions. All original amounts remain preserved in the source CSV.
TOTAMT reconciles to TAXAMT+PENAMT+INTAMT+FEEAMT for every row. This is arithmetic evidence, not an authoritative field definition.
